one_line: Eastern Ganga monarch of Odisha leading a bold offensive into Bengal against Mamluk governor Tughril Tughan Khan in the mid-13th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, tall and athletic with a commanding warrior-king build
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown Odishan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard line along the jaw; default expression calm but intense, projecting fearless confidence
appearance.hair: thick black hair, medium length, combed back from the forehead and tied into a short knot at the back; adorned with a simple gold circlet-style royal headband featuring a small central lotus motif
appearance.costume: royal Eastern Ganga battle attire: a fitted sleeveless mail shirt suggested under a deep-red silk angavastra-style upper drape wrapped over both shoulders, pinned at the right with a round gold brooch; beneath, an ivory-white cotton tunic with short sleeves; lower garment a rich saffron-orange dhoti, pleated and securely wrapped to mid-calf, with a narrow red border; sturdy brown leather boots covering the shins, appropriate for campaign terrain; waist bound with a broad dark-brown leather belt holding a simple gold buckle and a small pouch; jewellery kept practical—one gold armlet on the right arm with a stylised Gajalakshmi motif, a plain gold bracelet on the left wrist, and small round gold earrings; overall look is regal yet functional, clearly dressed for war rather than ceremony.
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved single-edged steel sword with a broad blade, plain iron crossguard, and a dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, carried sheathed at his left hip with the scabbard tip visible below the dhoti edge

ref_desc: Narasimhadeva I is a mid-30s, athletic Odishan king with medium-brown complexion, black hair tied in a short knot under a gold lotus headband, wearing deep-red angavastra, saffron dhoti, ivory tunic, leather belt and boots, gold armlet, and carrying a curved steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Narasimhadeva I: a mid-30s, tall, athletic Odishan warrior-king with an oval, strong-jawed face, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, thick brows, and a neat moustache with short beard line, looking calm yet intense. His thick black hair is combed back and tied into a short knot, topped by a simple gold circlet headband with a small central lotus motif. He wears a deep-red silk angavastra-style upper drape over both shoulders, pinned on the right with a round gold brooch, over an ivory-white short-sleeved cotton tunic. His lower garment is a saffron-orange dhoti with a narrow red border, pleated and wrapped to mid-calf, paired with sturdy brown leather boots covering the shins for campaigning. A broad dark-brown leather belt with a simple gold buckle cinches his waist and supports a pouch and the scabbard of his long, slightly curved single-edged steel sword, whose plain iron crossguard and dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt sit ready at his left hip. Add a gold armlet on his right arm, a plain gold bracelet on his left, and small round gold earrings, keeping the overall look regal but battle-ready, in a palette of deep red, saffron orange, ivory white, dark brown, and gold.
